title: 에디터 AI 가 이벤트 '페이지' 를 이해하지 못한 문제
rootCauses: system prompt had no page semantics; rule 8 encouraged multiplying pages
SIMPLE_PAGE_SCHEMA.conditions.items pointed at COMMAND_SCHEMA; CONDITION_SCHEMA enum hand-copied and missing 'run'
no detection of selfSwitch gates that nothing writes
make_villager itself emitted multiple unconditional pages
runtimeRule: io/pageResolution.resolveEventPage scans pages last->first and activates exactly one; last match wins (RM2K3)
pagePriorityDecision: unchanged — last-match-wins is correct; flipping to page-1 priority would kill every progression page in existing projects
randomDialoguePrimitive: m2Command commandId=m2-211-weighted-branch + fork(variable), all inside ONE page

liveTest.transport: local OpenAI-compatible shim backed by the session model (repo OPENROUTER_API_KEY returned 401); system prompt, tool schemas and tool execution are the real code paths

shippedDefectsFoundByNewLint.what: make_villager produced 3 unconditional pages from 2 dialogue lines; only the last ran
autoEvent ordered the selfSwitch latch page before the unconditional run page, so the latch never caught and auto events re-ran on every map entry

verification.vitest: 7 files / 104 tests passing in one run
verification.regressionBaseline: gate-flagged suites produce byte-identical failures on a clean origin/main checkout; stored gates baseline (2026-08-19) is stale
